Design gap (Type: design gap, for the Designer, not the Engineer): (1) Frame width 1116 and height 40 are raw in node 151:10 with no variable bound, so the component fills its container (spec says set to Fill) and hugs 36px (--size-control-sm). (2) The description asks for a visible focus indicator on :focus-visible but binds no token. Tab shows the browser default outline. (3) The node binds primitive spacing/lg for the Pager gap and spacing/xl for Controls, while the code uses semantic --gap-gutter and --gap-pane, which change under data-layout medium/expanded (Pager gap 24px there). The Designer must decide whether these gaps should follow layout mode.
